name: Arcturus Combat Bike
description: A heavily armored military motorcycle designed for rapid assault and pursuit operations. Reinforced frame, ballistic panels, integrated weapon systems, and a motor that produces enough torque to climb a vertical wall if the tires grip. The Combat Bike is the mount of corporate strike teams who need speed over armor. Riders wear matching powered armor and move in formations that have been refined through decades of corporate warfare. Seeing a pack of Combat Bikes screaming through a district means someone is about to have a very bad minute.
armament: Integrated forward-firing weapon mount, chaff launcher, smoke dispenser.
common_usage: Strike team deployment, high-speed pursuit, convoy escort, corporate warfare.
story_hooks: A Combat Bike rider goes AWOL with their vehicle and starts operating as a freelance enforcer in Tier 1 — an armored nightmare protecting the powerless
Combat Bikes communicate with each other via a tactical mesh network that someone has learned to intercept
physical_description: The Arcturus Combat Bike is a brutish machine of reinforced steel and carbon-composite plating, its frame welded thick and angular, painted matte black with faded corporate insignia still visible under rain-streaked grime. Ballistic panels wrap the engine block and rider position, pocked and scarred from repeated impacts, while exposed hydraulic lines and reinforced suspension components speak to heavy use. The seat is narrow and high, designed for quick dismounts, and hardpoints bristle along the frame where weapon systems mount—empty or occupied depending on the operation.
